My research focuses on experimental and behavioural economics and decision theory, with a particular interest in how self-perception influences economic decision-making in labour market and search environments. My research primarily employs experimental methods to test theoretical predictions and study individual behaviour, while I also conduct empirical research on related topics.


## Working Papers

[1] **“Sequential job search with ego utility.”** *Preparing for submission.*

[2] **“Too scared to search? A model of ego utility in job search.”** *Presented at the 3rd Xiangjiang River Forum, Hunan University, 2025.*

[3] **“Early-career adaptation under China’s dual-track academic system: Evidence from overseas-trained economists.”** With Lin Lin, Stuart McDonald, Zengbao Hu, and Bo Wang. *Submitted.*
